hook.line: If you're a business owner, this is going to trigger you.
hook.visual: Phone propped low, she sits by a shelf of board games, points at the lens, then starts peeling a mandarin; red-highlighted caption 'A BUSINESS OWNER'.

beats.what: Points at the camera and calls out business owners while starting to peel a mandarin
Opinion stated: too much time on social content, none on SEO or GEO
Stakes: 'costing you literally thousands', mandarin segments now in hand
The only cut; she keeps peeling and lists what she is chasing instead (trends, videos)
Lists the neglected work: product descriptions, blog posts, backlinks, PR articles
Leans back and gestures with a segment: AI search results bring free traffic
Contrast line: free website visitors versus social media; the clip ends mid-sentence

why_it_works: 'This is going to trigger you' promises a provocative opinion and invites disagreement in the comments
Peeling a mandarin gives the hands a small ongoing task, so a 34 s single shot still has visual motion and feels like a casual chat
An audience that makes social videos is told social videos are the problem, which is self-aware and shareable
Ends mid-sentence ('I don't'), so the loop restarts before the viewer swipes
weaknesses: No proof, numbers or screens; it is opinion only
No CTA and no next step for what to do about SEO or GEO
Quiet audio (-29.1 LUFS) and low phone angle
for_robert: Give Fred a small ongoing side task (nibbling, tidying a prop) during a long single-shot rant, so the frame has motion without cuts; keep it in the corner so it never competes with Robert's face.
